SYNTHETIC TEST CASE — entirely invented.
Follow-up for the planned fluoroscopy-guided LEFT L4 selective nerve root block. Symptoms unchanged. No new examination. Left L4 root accessed through L4–5. Contrast outlined the left L4 root without epidural, vascular or intrathecal spread. Routine uncomplicated root-only procedure; use authorized HTML defaults. One cc bupivacaine 0.5% at the root, 1 cc contrast, skin local 2 cc lidocaine 1%. No steroid. Pain diary, phone follow-up in two weeks. No medication changes. Preserve full previous chart.
